### ① Derived judgments

The diff changes no schema, code, gate or generated file. It publishes nothing. What it does is declare changes for later cards, and each declaration is judged here against the tree:

- `ActionType` loses `ask_ai` through `enumWithRetiredValues` (card #37856): right. `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:706` is a plain `z.enum` with `ask_ai` as its seventh member; the precedent at `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts:161,173` is as cited, and that file's prescriptions do close on `os migrate meta --from 18` (line 45).

- A dashboard header's `actionType` is the enum itself: right (`dashboard.zod.ts:72`).
- The page button rows take an open string and refuse `navigation` today: right for the two rows named (`component.zod.ts:4104`, `4142`–`4145`, and the `action:icon` twin). The list is incomplete: see S1.
- "A retired value does not show in the four generated baselines": right. The docblock of `enumWithRetiredValues` (`retired-key.ts`, "Registration") says so, and no `ask_ai` name is in `packages/spec/api-surface` or `export-origins`, so removing the spec-side refusals moves no baseline either.
- `ask_ai` was published only in a prerelease: right. `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` has it only under `## 19.0.0-next.0` (line 3; the next heading, `## 18.6.0`, is line 3126; the entry is at 1651). `.changeset/pre.json` is `mode: pre`, `tag: next`.
- `applyConversionsToStoredItem` hands a row back as stored when a conversion leaves no item: right. `packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts:172` returns `items[0]` only when `items.length` is above 0, else `item`.
- The showcase has the referenced case: right. `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/task-detail.page.ts:67` lists `showcase_ask_about_task` in the header; the action is declared with `type: 'ask_ai'` at `ui/actions/index.ts:289`–`293`.
- The door's own notices: right. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-stored-item-conversion.ts:8` warns once per conversion, row and process; `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts:1318` logs one summary line per conversion per artifact.
- "No validation rule on `main` reads an `ask_ai` action": right. `packages/lint` has no mention of it.
- The console readings (`surfaceRecord()` at `ChatFocusRow.tsx:29`, the pin, the switch prompt with its remembered decline, `console.ai.discussing` as `「正在看：{{target}}」`, `capabilities.focus`, `useAiSurfaceEnabled`, the word "pinned" in `ai-service.ts:1266`–`1271` and in `AiAgentCapabilitiesSchema.focus`): right.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no. `Metadata-protocol: none`. One file under `docs/adr/**`, which ships in no package; the PR carries `skip-changeset`, and `Check Changeset` is green on this head. That matches what the diff publishes, which is nothing. The `narrowed` declaration the text describes belongs to #37856's changeset, not to this PR.

Check-runs on this head when read: every run that was not skipped concluded `success` (the lint families, the type-check families, `Check Documentation Links`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check PR Size`, `Check Changeset`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`), except `Test Core (1/10)`, which was still `in_progress`. This record does not cover that run's conclusion. The PR is a draft.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions` in the os-dev-report is empty. Its three `out_of_scope_findings` and two deviations:

- Card #37856 says `ask_ai` shipped in 18.x: the report is correct and the card is wrong (see ①, CHANGELOG). The amendment states the true premise. Carrier #37856, as the report says.
- Epic #36996's "Done when": the amendment quotes the old paragraph character for character (checked against the epic's body) and gives the new one. The body edit waits on the merge; the seat's.
- The spec docblocks' word "pinned", assigned to #37861: answered, with one caution for the seat. `AiAgentCapabilitiesSchema.focus` carries the word in a `describe()` string, so the PR that changes it touches the published spec and its generated reference, and is reviewed on the schema face whatever lane #37861 sits in. The amendment's own claim holds: no key, type or gate changes.
- The two deviations (PR footer form; gates run with three linked modules) do not bear on the contract. The check-runs are the gate verdicts.

For the approver, escalated, not a defect: point 31 departs from ADR-0087's addendum of 2026-07-31, "Writes stay gated; reads diagnose, never drop", for a stored `action` row, and has the stored seam learn to answer "no item". The text says so in plain words and gives its reasons. ADR-0087 itself gets no note from this PR. Accepting the amendment accepts that exception for this one type.

SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff adds no read, no id materialisation and no join.

### ④ Design judgment

**The maintainer's words.** Each quotation the amendment calls a ruling was compared with topic #37853 by exact substring, quotation with its time:

- 「我们的问题是右上角的问AI太小太不明显了，然后项目经理才想到要加一个按钮」 (06:27Z): identical, time right.
- 「"页面里加按钮"的需求 作废」 (06:28Z): identical, time right (header and D7).
- 「撤掉 ask_ai(#37834 方案 B)」 (06:30Z): identical, time right (header and D7).
- 「应用不能改名」 (06:32Z): identical, time right.
- 「问 AI」 (06:33Z): identical, time right.
- 「全部按建议」 (07:12Z): identical, time right; the topic's "Rulings" list does put the removal of the 「改为问《X》？」 prompt under it, as the header says.
- The topic sentence quoted in D7, "Retire `ask_ai` with no compatibility shim, before 19.0 GA": identical. The cost the amendment reports beside it is a paraphrase and is not presented as a quotation.

**#37834's decision record (7212477335).** The header says that record "carries the first three". It does: 06:27Z, 06:28Z and 06:30Z, in the same characters. (It also carries the 07:12Z sentence on seat ownership, which the amendment does not quote.) The header and D7 call the 06:30Z words "the answer on that decision card"; the record's wording is "Decision card answer". D7's "Option B of that card is headed …" matches the card body's heading for B character for character, and "Alternatives" reads option A as the record does ("option A's preset-question buttons are void").

**Re-ruling and widening.** None found. The header's last bullet, D7's opening note and the introduction to points 25–32 each say that anything past the quoted words is this record's settlement, accepted with the maintainer's merge. Three things the header lists among what it records are not in the topic's "Rulings" list (the pin's removal, reading on demand, the behaviour at rest), and each one is labelled: points 26, 27 and 31.

**The settlements, each judged against the code and the rulings.**

- Point 25 (the first send fixes both; × stays): sound. The topic's target experience 7 puts no condition on when × falls back to the page chip, and its acceptance 5 ends "kept after the first send". The spec's own docblock says a focus does not follow navigation, so a sent conversation that never picks up a focus is the contract's reading. The request body is the authority, so a × after the first send needs nothing from the server. The card's "the first send fixes both" is read loosely here, and the point says so.
- Point 26 (the pin goes with the prompt): sound. The card names both under the 07:12Z answer; the topic's list names only the prompt, and the point reports exactly that.
- Points 27 and 28 (read on demand; the pointer): sound. The card's item 4 asks for it; the topic's acceptance 9 and release gate assume it. The pointer rules carry point 1's second condition and the epic's third ruling ("The pack reaches a model as a tool result, never as system-prompt text") without change, and D4's seam 1 is restated to match.
- Point 29 (every slot answers): the rule is sound, and the reading of the `type` key is a real correction to the card. The list of slots under it is short by two: S1.
- Point 30 (`os migrate meta` deletes only what nothing names): sound, and it is the card's rule. The test it names exists (`validate-action-name-refs.ts#ACTION_NAME_UNDEFINED`, with the docblock behaviour the text reports). Deleting an inline action or a button row on an author-invoked `--write` run follows from the same rule.
- Point 31 (at rest, read without the action): sound against the ruling and the card. "No compatibility shim" is kept: nothing read at rest opens the assistant. The card recommends this answer, and the topic's acceptance 8 ("installed metadata behaves as C0a says … brightrule boots on the new version") needs it. The mechanism is ADR-0087's (`entries/18/agent-structured-output-refused-members-removed.ts` is the cited kind). `ConversionContext` today holds only `reportTodo`, so telling the source run from the two doors does need the extension the text leaves to #37856. The departure from ADR-0087's addendum is stated, see ③.
- Point 32 (the epic's "Done when"): sound; the old text is quoted exactly.

**Findings.**

S1 (should-fix) — D7, "Every slot that takes an action type answers with it", says three kinds of slot take one on `main` at `adb65d16`, and for page components it names `actionType` on `action:button` and `action:icon` only. The tree has two more rows of the same kind: a member of `action:group` and of `action:menu` names its executor in an open string too, under the key `type` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, `actionContainerMemberShape`, line 4371: `type: z.string().optional()`), and both members refuse `navigation` today through the same refinements as the two nodes (lines 4491–4495 and 4522–4526, with the executor key `'type'`). `ROW_BUILTIN_EXECUTORS` (line 3900) is built from `ActionType.options`, so once `ask_ai` leaves the enum a member written `type: 'ask_ai'` parses as a host-registered handler and fails at the click. That is the outcome point 29 gives as the alternative not taken. The gap carries into point 29 and into the list that defines a legacy action ("a button row"). The heading's rule already covers these rows, so no ruling is missing, but the card's acceptance asks that #37856 need no further ruling, and the enumeration is what that card will build from. The fix is one clause: name the `type` key of `action:group` and `action:menu` members beside the two nodes' `actionType`, in D7 and in point 29.

Nits, none of which changes the contract:

- D6, "The first send fixes both": "sent with that turn and with every later one" is followed two sentences on by "× is the one change left". The first sentence wants "unless the user removes it".
- D8's third rule has a focused record with no pack answered by a refused `get_record_context` call and then `get_record`, which is two calls; the restated "Done when" counts one read, "`get_record` where the object has no pack". Which of the two the runtime produces is objectstack-ai/cloud#5113's, and objectstack-ai/cloud#5114 measures it.
- Point 30 rejects deleting names because it "edits a page the author laid out", while the same step deletes an inline button from a page. The rule is consistent (it deletes definitions, never references); the reason given for it is not.

No must-fix. S1 is open on this head and earns a delta review of its fix.
